why_it_matters: Granting roles/run.invoker to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers allows anyone on the Internet to invoke HTTP endpoints on the Cloud Run service without authentication.
Anonymous invocation can lead to unauthorized data retrieval, execution of internal workload logic, and unexpected compute consumption charges.
Restricting the IAM member to explicit service accounts or groups ensures that requests must present valid authentication tokens from authorized identities.
post_en:
Binding roles/run.invoker to allUsers allows unauthenticated Internet requests to reach Cloud Run HTTP endpoints.
Set the member argument in google_cloud_run_service_iam_member to an explicit identity such as a service account.
This change restricts service execution to authenticated callers inside authorized projects or groups.
CKV_GCP_102 fails the first version and passes the second.
